title: Green Brown Rice Pilaf with Peas and Coconut Milk
description: Brown rice is par-boiled like pasta, then simmered with ginger, garlic, zucchini, green curry paste and coconut milk, with peas stirred through and a squeeze of lime at the end.

steps.text: Cook the rice in a pot of plenty of boiling water for 15 minutes until just softened, then drain.

Heat the butter in a medium pot and sweat the finely chopped onion, crushed garlic and grated ginger for 3 minutes until softened. Add the curry paste and stir for a minute until fragrant. Add the zucchini (halved lengthways and sliced on the diagonal) and the rice and stir for 1-2 minutes.
Add the boiling water and coconut milk, season with salt and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the peas, stir and cook covered for 10 more minutes. Season with the juice and zest of 2 limes (or 1 lemon) and serve.
